method: Compiled the three Python fences, executed the resolver and topic-gate examples, tested supersession chains, scope partitioning, mixed evidence, expiry and timezone boundaries, and checked the deletion protocol ordering. No provider calls or external store operations were performed.
limitations: Historical timestamp/no-timestamp provider runs are preserved only as a 2026-10-08 summary; raw requests, responses, prompt snapshots, exact route and scorer were unavailable and were not reproduced.
The local resolver trusts normalized scope/key/source/version metadata and does not establish semantic equivalence or user intent.
Deletion and outbox interfaces are conceptual; no database transaction, index, cache, replica, backup, authorization integration or physical erasure was executed.
Topic thresholds and expiry examples are constructed policy placeholders, not production defaults.
